summary: Single Leg X Reimagined develops gi entries, sweeps and submissions with Adam Wardzinski.
description: A gi single-leg-X course with butterfly and shin-to-shin entries, fabric-grip sweeps and passing counters.
overview: Adam Wardzinski’s Single Leg X Reimagined connects butterfly, shin-to-shin and De La Riva entries to sweeping and submission options. Sleeve and lapel variations give it a distinct gi emphasis. The four volumes also cover technical stand-ups, back takes and responses to long-step and pressure passing.

guide.display_title: Adam Wardzinski: Single Leg X in the Gi

fits: You want single-leg-X offense adapted to gi grips, including sleeve and lapel sweep variations.

includes: Entries from butterfly, shin-to-shin and De La Riva; scissor, hook and overhead sweeps.
Technical stand-ups, back takes, foot locks and counters to pulling and passing.
limits: Several attacks depend on fabric grips, so this is not an exclusively no-gi single-leg-X course.
